description: Discovery call full of numbers, an executive and a date, none of which is a budget, decision maker, or seller meeting.

turns.text: Can you give me a sense of the business before we get into the tool?
Sure. We're about a forty-million-dollar company, roughly two hundred people, eleven warehouses.
Twenty-two agents. We handle maybe nine thousand tickets a month, it's a lot.
Who else cares about fixing this?
Our CEO, Mariana Solis, asks about ticket backlog in basically every staff meeting. I'll share your deck with her.
Makes sense. Is there anything coming up on your side?
Our board meets on the 28th, so I'm buried in prep until then.

budget.rationale: Company revenue is not a budget for this purchase (§2.1). No budget is discussed.

evidence.quote: Our CEO, Mariana Solis, asks about ticket backlog in basically every staff meeting. I'll share your deck with her.

decisionMaker.rationale: Being interested and receiving the deck gives no decision or approval role; a senior title alone isn't final authority (§2.2).

nextMeeting.rationale: The customer's internal board meeting is not a seller meeting (§2.3).
